requirements.title: Canonical source hierarchy
requirements.summary: Global architecture, shared contracts, per-skill instructions and executable evidence have explicit precedence.

requirements.title: Explicit exact-head identity
requirements.summary: Candidate-bound evidence remains tied to the material identity it examined and later material writes invalidate dependent evidence.

requirements.title: Fail-closed unknown semantics
requirements.summary: Missing or ambiguous material evidence never becomes implicit approval or fabricated zero.

requirements.title: Bounded remediation and retries
requirements.summary: Implementation, CI and audit remediation are bounded and cannot form open-ended AI-on-AI loops.

requirements.title: Independent read-only audit
requirements.summary: Independent audit is isolated from implementation authority and does not mutate the candidate.

requirements.title: Exclusive CI ownership transfer
requirements.summary: Delivery snapshot and CI remediation ownership are mutually exclusive for the same material SHA and return control structurally.

requirements.title: Progressive context with insufficient-context blocking
requirements.summary: Skills load context progressively but must block semantic approval when required material context is unavailable.

requirements.title: No implicit merge authority
requirements.summary: Skill approval and release readiness never imply native merge enforcement or merge authority.

requirements.title: Canonical shared-contract ownership
requirements.summary: entregar-issue owns shared contracts and generated copies in other skills remain synchronized.

requirements.title: Observable state without fabricated values
requirements.summary: Known zero, known value, partial and unknown remain distinguishable in metrics and operational evidence.

requirements.title: Machine-readable skill catalog
requirements.summary: Every validated skill is registered with purpose, modes, triggers, authority and required capabilities in one catalog.

requirements.title: Generated contract synchronization
requirements.summary: Generated contract copies and files declared in config/shared-files.json are checked against canonical bytes and cannot drift silently.

requirements.title: Documentation reference integrity
requirements.summary: Local Markdown links, skill references and generated catalog documentation remain resolvable.

requirements.title: Fail-closed capability contract
requirements.summary: Skills declare required capabilities and deterministic fallbacks so missing access cannot become implicit success.

requirements.title: Reproducible release versioning
requirements.summary: Public SemVer releases, temporal catalog versions and contract lineage are declared in a compatibility manifest with migration notes.

requirements.title: Portable platform adapters
requirements.summary: Supported AI hosts use one adapter manifest, progressive loading order and host-declared capabilities without assuming provider access.

requirements.title: Behavioral evaluation harness
requirements.summary: Versioned evaluation cases, explicit runtime availability, bounded metrics and hashable reports detect behavioral regressions without replacing deterministic gates.

requirements.title: Adversarial behavioral regression matrix
requirements.summary: The evaluation harness keeps sibling cases and deterministic baselines for selection, authority, capabilities, evidence, context and related fail-closed boundaries.

requirements.title: No unreachable operational files
requirements.summary: Every reference, script and schema shipped by a skill is reachable from its SKILL.md; dead files are deleted instead of left to drift.

requirements.title: Canonical issue specification form
requirements.summary: The issue body that feeds requirement closure has a versioned canonical form: normative sections are declared once, templates stay inert so no placeholder becomes a requirement candidate, and the declaration is cross-checked against the independent audit parser.

requirements.title: Resolved selection is proven, not only abstention
requirements.summary: The behavioral matrix covers resolved skill selection grounded in the real router, keeps the no-match case explicitly unknown, and exercises the persisted replay report in CI.

requirements.title: Enforced context budget
requirements.summary: Control planes and references are bounded by measured bytes per file and characters per line, with an allowance list whose entries must equal the current measurement and therefore can only shrink.

requirements.title: Genericity of permanent assets is enforced
requirements.summary: The genericity validator blocks numbered issue coupling, issue-derived permanent rules, absolute host paths, concrete identifiers in Markdown prose outside delimited examples, and concrete external hosts, and the workflow runs it over the catalog root.

requirements.title: Long references are navigable
requirements.summary: Every reference above the declared byte threshold declares when it should be read and exposes an index whose anchors resolve and whose entries cover every section, so progressive loading can be selective.

requirements.title: Trusted auditor registry has a declared procedure
requirements.summary: The security document declares custody, producer and approver separation, key handling, rotation, revocation and the single-operator limitation, and the registry entry builder derives the fingerprint from the published key and refuses material the schema rejects.

requirements.title: Dependency resolution is reproducible and exceptions are declared
requirements.summary: Every manifest in the repository, including the catalogue tooling manifest at the root, has a sibling lockfile pinning exact versions, the chosen artifact and sha256 hashes of the transitive closure; an offline deterministic validator rejects manifest, lockfile or policy paths that resolve outside the repository root, manifests that are not regular files, lockfiles not paired nominally with a manifest and orphan lockfiles outside the root, drift, unresolvable, non-manifest or out-of-root includes, manifest options it does not implement, lockfile options other than --hash, uninterpretable requirement lines and direct URL references, pinned versions that do not satisfy the declared specifier, missing hashes, artifact declarations whose name, version or distribution grammar do not match the locked resolution, unevaluable environment markers and malformed policy exceptions that do not name an existing locked resolution; version, specifier, requirement, marker and distribution grammar is interpreted by packaging, declared at the root and installed from the root lockfile, so a form the reference implementation of PEPs 440, 508 and 427 refuses fails instead of being approximated, markers are evaluated against the interpreter running the gate rather than the editable context comment, the required sequence also re-resolves the closure and fails when the lockfile is not the closure of its manifest, comparing packages, versions and dependency edges independently of the resolving environment, and the advisory lookup and the digest verification against the real artifact run outside the required sequence and report UNKNOWN instead of success when they cannot verify.

requirements.title: Static analysis is real, declared and impossible to weaken silently
requirements.summary: Python code in the catalogue is checked by a deterministic, offline gate that runs Ruff with a selection derived from a versioned policy and fails on any diagnostic of an applied rule; every rule family in the installed tool catalogue appears exactly once in the policy as applied, partially applied with the disabled part declared, or dismissed with a written reason, so a family added by a tool upgrade or a dismissal without a reason fails the gate and coverage cannot shrink silently; coverage is checked at the rule level, so an applied family with a narrow selection, a partial family that leaves one of its rules undecided, a partial family that disables the whole family and an entry belonging to another family all fail; dismissed and partial entries carry a reason of substantive length and applied entries carry none; the tool version is pinned in the manifest and the lockfile and declared in the policy, and a divergence between installed and declared version fails instead of passing; the gate runs with the declared language target and line length, without cache and without network; inline suppression is accepted only when the code is in the allowed list and the same line carries its own justification after the separator, the scanner reads the forms the tool recognises, including the marker in any case and the file-level directive with a `ruff:` or `flake8:` prefix, a file-level directive without codes is refused, comments are read from real comment tokens so a directive inside a string is not a suppression, and a directive that suppresses nothing fails; the scanned scope is declared in the policy, and a covered file that is a symlink outside the root, an unreadable directory, a directory of the scope that is a symbolic link, a scanned set without any covered file, and a tool output that is empty or malformed fail with an explicit cause instead of shrinking the analysed set or treating emptiness as approval; an inline justification needs its own text after the separator, an entry must carry the exact family prefix rather than a textual prefix and must be written in upper case, a broken or cyclic symbolic link and the disappearance of the tool executable between the version check and the analysis fail instead of approving the tree, the documented-sequence test reads the workflow steps with a YAML parser rather than with regular expressions over the text, compares every step, including external actions, requiring each one to be classified as validation or declared as non-validation, and a structurally invalid policy stops the validation with its cause instead of raising a traceback or reporting the tool symptom over an invalid selection, with the workflow document itself validated fail-closed (single document, duplicated keys compared by constructed value so that true and True or 01 and 1 count as the same key, uncomparable keys refused instead of raising, jobs, job, steps and step shape checked, run or uses carrying text), exact integers required where an integer is declared, so that neither a boolean nor a fraction passes by comparison, a family state that is not text refused, each run line matched against one declared grammar and its target required to be a validation script declared one by one that exists as a regular file under the root, without symbolic links, or a declared module, so that composed, substituted, quoted, escaped, file-descriptor, wrapped or extra-redirected commands are refused and a textual marker in an argument cannot promote an arbitrary script, enforced by a mandatory validator rather than only by a test, with the declared tool install, tool invocation and description fields required in exact form and unreadable inputs reported instead of raised; the repository tree passes clean, and the aggregate validator, the CI sequence, the README and AGENTS.md run the gate in the same position.

requirements.title: Global hygiene is measured on the whole tree, on demand, with declared precision
requirements.summary: Perfil de higienizacao global sob demanda: mede duplicacao por AST com identificador apagado no proprio no, inclusive o capturado por padrao estrutural e o apelido de excecao, de nome global e de import, com apenas o literal de documentacao removido e com limiar contado em instrucoes do corpo; mede modulo e simbolo mortos com citacao resolvida por caminho contra o escopo medido, com `..` recusado apenas quando sai da raiz e import relativo exigindo pacote declarado, nunca por caminho absoluto e nunca por marcador de lugar aberto, exigindo que o sufixo declarado termine o nome, seguindo a gramatica de identificador de Python em vez de classe de caractere, e alcancando o modulo de pacote por import do proprio nome ou de subpacote; mede dependencia declarada e nunca importada, em manifest cujo nome casa com o conjunto declarado em manifest_patterns, lido pelo formato, com pyproject.toml por project.dependencies, optional-dependencies e tabelas do Poetry, com python fora da contagem nas duas formas, formato sem leitura declarada em cobertura nao analisada, arquivo de trava reconhecido por convencao de nome e requisito de VCS pelo fragmento egg, e mede complexidade do proprio corpo contra linha de base; cada classe declara o que nao ve, e formatos de texto, exclusao de teste, arquivo de pacote e nomes de protocolo sao declarados na politica, com supressor exigindo nome e motivo escritos, sem excecao fixa no codigo, sem chave de decisao ausente, sem chave de classe desconhecida e sem chave de decisao valida apenas na classe a que pertence, com a varredura reprovando politica incompleta do mesmo modo que o validador e antes de medir; a politica e a unica fonte de limiar, escopo, exclusao, excecao e linha de base, exclusao de diretorio cobre a subarvore inteira e exclusao de caminho exige motivo escrito em caminho canonico dentro da raiz, com tudo visivel no relatorio; achado aberto em classe controlada exige excecao com justificativa escrita, exigida tambem pelo contrato do relatorio, que o produtor confere antes de gravar, e nem o relatorio nem o diretorio de work items podem ser gravados dentro da arvore medida, com o relatorio publicado somente depois de a politica passar; classe medida nao aceita excecao item a item, cresce apenas por entrada nova na historia declarada com motivo e reduz sem exigir justificativa, com diretorio excluido exigido como caminho relativo canonico, sem `..` nem barra duplicada, e visivel no relatorio JSON e no Markdown; cobertura que encolhe em silencio reprova nos dois sentidos, com diretorio ilegivel, link de diretorio, manifest ilegivel, link quebrado, link em ciclo e alvo direcionado inexistente ou externo visiveis em qualquer modo, com alvo externo mantendo o escopo vazio em vez de reabrir o percurso livre, com recusa rotulada a partir da raiz, cobertura declarada em caminho relativo canonico e motivo escrito sem caminho absoluto, para que copias equivalentes da arvore produzam o mesmo relatorio; a citacao resolve contra o escopo medido, sem autocitacao e sem link de corpus fora da raiz, e a identidade do achado deriva do conteudo material, com rotulo proprio para nome repetido no mesmo arquivo, contando todas as definicoes e na ordem de aparicao do texto; a varredura e deterministica, offline e somente leitura; relatorio e work item sao conferidos contra os proprios contratos em memoria; decisao declarada como booleana exige booleano; versao da politica exige o inteiro exato; linha de base nao entra em classe controlada nem pela historia e nao aceita valor negativo; varredura e gerador recusam dois artefatos no mesmo caminho, inclusive escritos de forma diferente, saida reutilizada e destino com mais de um link, com relatorio decimal recusado; toda classe medida exige linha de base declarada, com as chaves da catraca valendo em toda classe; import relativo que sobe alem do pacote nao soma o pacote do importador; destino de `--report` e `--markdown` exige arquivo e o de `--out-dir` e conferido pelo que existe de fato, inclusive link quebrado; o produtor aplica o mesmo contrato decimal do gate; escopo fora do tipo reprova a politica; citacao de nome solto resolve contra o conjunto medido em qualquer forma de alvo; publicacao e atomica por arquivo temporario publicado com `os.replace`, sem destino truncado, sem destruir o artefato anterior, sem temporario orfao, com registro do temporario antes da escrita e com reversao do que ja foi publicado quando o lote falha, declarando reversao incompleta e temporario residual com codigo proprio; link quebrado ou em ciclo e recusa visivel na cobertura; o gerador de work item exige coerencia e nao aprovacao;  qualquer componente linkado do alvo recusa o alvo inteiro;  alvo recusado nao restringe manifest;  destino que e diretorio e recusado antes de publicar; a grafia do alvo e normalizada e o rotulo publicado e canonico;  alvo direcionado que e link de diretorio e recusado; identidade de excecao e validada no formato do relatorio; import absoluto resolve na raiz e no diretorio do importador; varredura direcionada nao acusa excecao fora do alvo como orfa; destino em ciclo de links e pai que nao e diretorio sao recusados antes da escrita; e o gerador de work items confere a politica, recusa buraco de cobertura e exige relatorio da propria arvore, inclusive por `--report`.
